subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The current code exposes partial primitives, but choosing a new plugin SDK surface affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with an open inbound_activity hook proposal.

options.title: Document System Events First
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a typed SDK hook or adapter for non-message inbound activity and align it with the related inbound_activity PR before merging an implementation.

options.title: Request Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot solve the use case.

recommendation.title: Document System Events First
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from current blame on the central SDK/channel runtime surfaces and prior issue-review routing, with hook-contract input likely needed from vincentkoc.
